Fiction.Bank:CheckingDebit.Types:debitDe: Paid from checking: checking alone covered the payment; savings is untouched.
Paid with savings transfer: checking was short, so the shortfall (only the shortfall) moved from savings to checking and the payment was made.
Rejected, insufficient funds: checking and savings together could not cover the payment. Nothing moves.
Rejected, invalid amount: the payment amount was zero or negative. Nothing moves.
Rejected, over payment limit: the payment is above its method's per-payment limit, even if the money is there. Nothing moves.
Fiction.Bank:CheckingDebit.Types:debitRe: Request ID: identifies this payment request so it can be looked up, corrected and traced.
Payment method: check, ATM, Zelle or wire; sets the per-payment limit.
Amount: the payment amount to debit from checking, in US dollars.
Checking balance: the customer's checking balance before the payment, in US dollars.
Savings balance: the customer's linked savings balance before the payment, in US dollars; used to cover a checking shortfall.
Decision: what the bank did with the payment (paid, paid with savings transfer, or rejected and why).
Savings transfer: US dollars moved from savings to checking to cover the shortfall; zero unless paid with a savings transfer.
Checking balance after: checking after the payment and any savings transfer, in US dollars.
Savings balance after: savings after any transfer to checking, in US dollars.
Fiction.Bank:CheckingDebit.Types:payment: Check: a paper check; limited to $10,000 per payment (exactly $10,000 is allowed).
ATM: a withdrawal at an ATM; limited to $6,000 per payment.
Zelle: a Zelle transfer; limited to $1,000 per payment.
Wire: a wire transfer; no per-payment limit.
